_options._note: JSON has no // comments, so this self-doc block is ignored by the loader.
_options.cache_universe: ['NIFTY50', 'NIFTY100', 'NIFTY200', 'NIFTY500'] — consumed by src/market_data/ohlcv_downloader.py's --universe CLI default. Only nifty50/nifty500 currently wired there; nifty100/200 fall back to nifty50 until that script's dispatch is extended.
_options.trade_universe: ['NIFTY50', 'NIFTY100', 'NIFTY200', 'NIFTY500'] — the GLOBAL default watchlist (src/orchestrator.py boot + intraday scan). Any other value silently falls back to NIFTY50. NIFTY100/200/500 require their data/nifty{100,200,500}_symbols.json cache to exist (fetched via `python -m src.market_data.ohlcv_downloader --universe nifty500`, etc.) — missing cache also falls back to NIFTY50 (logged as index_universe_cache_missing).
_options._per_strategy_override: Swing (DAILY) strategies are NOT limited to trade_universe above — each strategy JSON's universe_filter.index_filter (e.g. minervini_vcp.json / oneil_canslim.json declare 'NIFTY500') is resolved independently by _swing_signal_scan_loop via the same NIFTY50/100/200/500 cache files. Set index_filter per-strategy to widen just that strategy's universe without changing the global default here.
